rationale: dual_domain_n2i-claude-agentic: train_n=200, val_n=24, batch_size=1, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42, warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=12, n_iter=600, outer_wall_s=1700, lr=0.0001, unet_c=16, rationale=iter-13: ONE knob -> val_n 12 -> 24 (2x val scenes), at the seed42/ep12/lr1e-4/warm_start=True/n_iter600/grad_clip1.0 PEAK base (iter-10, SSIM 0.4724). A WIDER-BASIS CEILING-CONFIRMATION read (the handoff's explicit candidate: 'a LARGER val_n for a tighter ceiling estimate'). This is a CONFIRMATION move, NOT a ceiling-raiser -- no ceiling-raiser remains for the over-parameterized U-Net on this 128-view synthetic substrate. DIAGNOSIS (numbers, not pixels): the 3 val_n=12 seed reads landed seed42=0.4724 (iter-10), seed123=0.4484 (iter-11), seed7=0.4305 (iter-12) -> 3-seed mean 0.4504, std 0.0173. seed7 fell just BELOW the predicted [0.44,0.48] band, so the per-scan stochastic floor is slightly WIDER than the iter-10/11 pair suggested (std ~0.017 not ~0.012). The ceiling estimate's BASIS is still only 12 scenes per read; whether the ~0.47 seed42 mean is representative of a wider scene set is the one remaining un-pinned-down quantity in the ceiling documentation. FAILURE MODE = the 0.466 M-param U-Net OVERFITS each single noisy 128-view sparse-phantom scan (the 6-param bilateral twin physically cannot, which is why the twin clears baseline at hr+0.33 while this U-Net stays hr~0 at ~0.45-0.51 SSIM); the per-image fit has an init-driven stochastic noise floor that a wider val basis shrinks but does not eliminate. EXHAUSTED axes (do NOT retry, per handoff): n_iter (iter-2 1200 steps 0.4785->0.4293, per-scan overfit), warm_start (iter-8 off -0.0595, load-bearing-positive), lr (iter-3 1e-3->1e-4 + iter-9 1e-4->2e-4 bracket 1e-4 as optimal), pretrain_epochs (ep12 peak, ep18 worse 0.5016), unet_c (design-doc warned-against; mayo n2i c16->c32 flat). grad_clip=1.0 is LOAD-BEARING (the 128/2304-view FBP-adjoint overflow guard, mandatory) and seed is EXHAUSTED (3 reads at val_n=12). LEVER CHOICE (the genuinely-untried confirmation knob, exactly the handoff's named candidate): val_n 12 -> 24 at the seed42 PEAK config. Doubling the val scenes averages the per-scan SSIM over 2x as many independent draws, shrinking the standard error of the ceiling estimate by ~sqrt(2) and directly testing whether the 12-scene seed42 mean (0.4724) is representative of a wider scene set. HYPOTHESIS: at val_n=24 the seed42 mean lands near the seed42/val_n=12 family (~0.46-0.48), with a TIGHTER read than the 12-scene number -- a more-trustworthy ~0.46-0.47 finalized ceiling for the per-image U-Net N2I on this synthetic 128-view substrate. hr stays ~0 (structurally FBP-bounded on dense 128-view phantoms). FALSIFIER: if the val_n=24 seed42 mean lands FAR from 0.4724 (e.g. <0.43 or >0.50), the 12-scene val set was itself unrepresentative and the ceiling claim needs the wider 24-scene basis going forward. NOTE: val_n changes absolute-SSIM comparability vs the 12-scene history -- that is the POINT (a cleaner, less-noisy basis), recorded here so future iters read this number against THIS iter. outer_wall_s raised 1200 -> 1700 is a BUDGET-ACCOMMODATION for the doubled scene loop (a time-guard, not a research knob -- it does not change recon quality, only prevents the 24-scene loop from being truncated mid-pass), NOT a second hypothesis knob. WALL: warm 12x200=2400 + per-image 24x600=14400 = 16800 steps @ ~0.083 s/step ~= 1394 s, under the raised outer_wall_s=1700 guard (per_scene_s = 1700/24 ~= 71 s, ample for 600 steps @ ~0.083 s/step ~= 50 s) and under the 00:30:00 (1800 s) sbatch wall. All recon-affecting knobs IDENTICAL to the iter-10 seed42 PEAK config (train_n=200, batch_size=1, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42, warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=12, n_iter=600, lr=1e-4, unet_c=16); ONLY val_n 12 -> 24 changed (+ outer_wall_s budget accommodation).
